Definition: to strip off, i.e. (partially) scrape; by implication, to segregate (as an angle)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to scrape, scrape off, cut off; 1a) (Hiphil) to scrape; 2) to be cornered, be set in corners; 2a) (Hophal) to cut off places, make corners
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
